title: plan-gate: a Terraform plan JSON gate for CI
area: Go for platform tooling, Terraform at scale
scenario: Tessellate is bringing hundreds of hand-built GCP resources under Terraform in small import batches, and last month a reviewer nearly approved a batch whose plan replaced the core VPC. The platform team wants a small Go binary in every Terraform pipeline (and in the import agent's verification step) that reads terraform show -json output, prints a terraform-style summary, enforces protected types and an imports-only mode for migration PRs, never prints sensitive values, and exits with codes CI can act on.
task: Classify every resource change, including both replace orders, read, no-op and imports
Summarize like terraform (a replacement counts as add and destroy) and validate the plan format
Diff top-level attributes and mask anything marked sensitive, at any depth
Evaluate the policy: protected types, imports-only actions and attribute allow-list
Wire the CLI: text and --json output, exit 0 / 1 / 2
acceptance: Visible and hidden go test suites pass with -race
No sensitive value appears in text or JSON output
Parse and usage errors exit 2 and never print PASS
ANSWER.md explains why the gate reads the plan rather than the code, and where it runs in CI
